response: Look at what global instability caused by foreign conflicts does to nations trying to secure their own borders and economic sovereignty. The ongoing conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran is directly driving up global oil prices and threatening hardworking families in India at the pump. While the government has rightly stepped in to implement measures such as reducing excise duties to shield consumers from potential price hikes, we all know that there is no free lunch—these interventions come at a direct cost to government revenue and risk fueling inflation. When a nation relies so heavily on crude oil imports, its economic stability is held hostage by distant geopolitical chaos. This is a stark reminder that true national security and family values require energy independence, strict fiscal responsibility, and putting our own people first before the fallout from foreign entanglements wrecks the domestic economy.
